method: Seeded random sample (seed 20261002, audit-sample.mjs logic) of 48 of the 636 scored rows. One human-in-the-loop reviewer (the research agent) reread the input, engine transcript and both ASR transcripts and agreed or disagreed with each rubric label (render_error / number_misread / mixed_convention). Nobody listened to the clips; this audits the classifier against the transcripts, not against the ear.

disagree.audit: 'ml' voiced as letters is common Indian English; judge is stricter than the rubric intends
uncertain: A='रूण', B='रु. 7'; could be the voice or ASR, should have been asr_suspect

undetermined_note: 6/48 rows (13%) had digits in BOTH transcripts for the notation span (e.g. 0.274, 3.75, 2.5, H2O), so the reading convention cannot be recovered from text; the classifier left them unflagged. Every rate in tables.md is therefore a LOWER bound on the written arm, where digits are the input.
